objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Change the victim's colour from another origin and retrieve the flag (/ctf/flag).
hints: The state-changing form carries nothing an attacker cannot guess.
Read about cross-site request forgery and anti-CSRF tokens.

steps.title: Find the gap
steps.prompt: What does the colour form lack that would stop forged requests?

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: What class of vulnerability is this? (acronym accepted)
